introHtml: Reflective pet collars add a critical safety feature for dogs walked at dawn, dusk, or night. Unlike standard collars, these incorporate high-visibility materials that catch headlights and streetlights, helping drivers and cyclists spot pets from a distance. For businesses in pet care, outdoor recreation, or safety, custom reflective collars offer practical brand exposure while promoting responsible pet ownership. Decorate with woven labels or screen-printed logos for a durable, professional finish that stands up to daily wear.
